sam: Quick pre-merge check — PR #4989 touches how the edge-runner obtains credentials. Changing the service account scopes and adding a short-lived token exchange flow. Can sec please confirm any risk of tenant credential exposure? Details below.

elaine: Can you paste the files changed + the example env var and the exact token lifetime? Who needs to give lgtm?

sam: Files changed: `services/edge-runner/auth.py`, `deploy/k8s/edge-deployment.yaml`, `tests/fixtures/edge_tokens.json`. Env var added: `EDGE_SEALED=true` (temporary). Token lifetime config: `EDGE_TOKEN_TTL=15m` (was `24h`). Diff snippet:```diff
--- a/services/edge-runner/auth.py
+++ b/services/edge-runner/auth.py
@@ -12,7 +12,11 @@
-    TOKEN_TTL = timedelta(hours=24)
+    # reduced TTL: short-lived tokens via exchange endpoint
+    TOKEN_TTL = timedelta(minutes=15)
+    # add exchange endpoint to swap long-lived SA token for short-lived token
+    def exchange_token(sa_token):
+        ...
```

jamie: Quick flag — the new flow writes some debug lines to stdout in failure cases. Make sure we don't accidentally log raw tokens. Also confirm no token strings in test fixtures.

marco: I've flagged the PR and assigned @elaine as sec reviewer. I'll run the secret scanner now: `make scan-secrets` and post results.

security-bot: Automated secret-scan: 1 candidate match in `tests/fixtures/edge_tokens.json` -> value: `EDGE_SEALED`. Classification: probable test token placeholder. Recommendation: replace with `__TEST_PLACEHOLDER__` or remove before merge.

elaine: Quick manual review notes: lowering TTL to 15m is good. The bigger issues: (1) `EDGE_SEALED` appears in fixtures — remove or mark as test-only; (2) add a runbook blurb to PR describing fallback behavior if token exchange fails (how to rotate/rollback); (3) please ensure logs redact `exchange_token` input/output — add a small util `redact_token()` and call it in the except blocks.

sam: Ack — I'll remove the fixture value, add the runbook snippet in PR body, and update the logging to use `redact_token()`. One question: do we need a KMS/HSM review for the exchange endpoint? It uses the same KMS key as other services.

elaine: Not necessary for the key itself if you're reusing an existing key, but document the KMS usage in the runbook and scope the SA to the minimum required permissions. Also add a short sentence about audit logs to the PR.

infra-oncall: Quick network check — the exchange endpoint is internal-only; no new egress rules required. If you merge today before 17:00 UTC we can observe canary lane. If token exchange fails we can flip rollout to previous image.

jamie: Also please add a CI smoke test: `tests/smoke/test_token_exchange.py` that uses a mocked KMS client and asserts tokens are not logged (we already have log-capture helpers).

sam: Thanks — I'll push updates in ~30m and ping for final lgtm. Adding runbook snippet now and will remove `EDGE_SEALED` from fixtures. :thumbsup:

marco: Sounds good, thanks for moving fast. I will re-run `make scan-secrets` after your push and post results.

security-bot: Reminder: mark the PR with the label `sec-review:complete` once the fixture and logging items are addressed.
